listen.footer: Trust levels vary. Rhonda Patrick is the most rigorous. Greenfield is useful on exercise and the dad's role but leans thin on some claims. Diary Of A CEO guests are credentialed but the titles overstate — Komisar's daycare claims are contested among developmental researchers. Anything about supplements, risk, or birth decisions goes to the OB.
